verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents plain-English operation in several places. You can ask questions about your business in plain English, and Accounting AI runs prompts on top of the general ledger. Its MCP connects your account to Claude for natural conversation across ledger tools, and in Beta it can make write changes, confirming each with you first. missing for 10: write/command operation via natural language is still Beta, no independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language control in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Ask anything about your business, instantly, in plain English.
Puzzle's MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration lets you connect your Puzzle account directly to Claude, giving you instant access to your financial data through natural conversation
With write access turned on (Beta), your assistant can also make changes... It confirms each change with you before making it.
Accounting AI runs prompts on top of your general ledger.
described once, done automatically, reviewed by you before anything's final.
